facts.fact: ARTCI posted its call for a public consultation on net neutrality guidelines on its website, open 6 July to 6 August 2026, with responses accepted by email.

The telecoms regulator ARTCI opened a public consultation from 6 July to 6 August 2026 on guidelines for net neutrality, inviting all stakeholders and interested individuals or entities; it says it will publish all responses with a summary report.

CIV.note: Publication of responses is promised, not yet reported.
